Process

Three steps, no surprises.

I

Listen

A two-hour visit: how you live, what stays, what drives you mad. You get a short brief the same week.

II

Design

Layouts, a material board and lighting plan. Two rounds of changes, then drawings.

III

Make it real

We order, coordinate the trades and style the rooms – or hand you a clear shopping list.

Questions

Good to know.

Do you work outside Copenhagen?

Yes – remote projects across Scandinavia, with one or two visits.

Can we buy the furniture ourselves?

Of course. You get a shopping list with links and alternatives.

How long does a whole home take?

About six weeks of design, then the build at your builder’s pace.

Do you work with landlords and rentals?

Yes – we specialise in changes you can take with you.
